newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH LEZAJSK BREWERY SALE SEEN DELAYED -MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: POLISH LEZAJSK BREWERY SALE SEEN DELAYED -MINISTER.

text.p: The sale of Polish brewery Zaklady Piwowarskie w Lezajsku SA> (Lezajsk) is likely to be delayed as two of the shortlisted bidders withdrew from negotiations, the privatisation minister said on Tuesday.
Wieslaw Kaczmarek told a news conference that the ministry planned to begin negotiations with a third shortlisted investor, but he declined to name the firm.
"We will start negotiations with the third shortlisted investor," he said.
The privatisation ministry is offering up to 75 percent of Lezajsk, in southeastern Poland, while 20 percent is earmarked for employees and five percent for reprivatisation claims.
Lezajsk recorded a 90,000-zloty net profit in 1994 against 71.7 million zlotys in sales.
The ministry has not published data for 1995.
